dragon-citadel.campaign.name: Dragon Citadel
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage01.final: The first enemy laughs at a city without dragons. Teach him that Dragon Citadel begins with accuracy before it releases the storm.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage01.intro: Dragon Citadel is only lifting its first gates. You do not yet command beasts or titans, only marksmen trained to strike the gap in a breastplate from impossible range.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage01.lesson: Sharpshooters are expensive because each one carries a runic crossbow and ammunition hardened in dragon fire. Keep them protected and let their precision pay for itself.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage01.title: Spark of the Citadel
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage02.final: The enemy wants to break your golem molds before they learn to walk. Show him how long stone can fight when a ruby heart beats inside it.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage02.intro: The foundries wake. Gold Golems are not fast, but they are the promise that your shooters will survive the first charge.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage02.lesson: Diamond Golems endure magic and steel. Ruby Golems start at 10 Attack, 10 Defense and 100 Health, then gain +2 Attack, +1 Defense and +10 Health after every completed battle round in BILLADENC4.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage02.title: Golden Cores
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage03.final: The mages believed the storm could be locked in crystal. Open it.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage03.intro: Titans do not serve Dragon Citadel out of love. They serve because only these walls are tall enough to speak with the storm as an equal.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage03.lesson: Titans are costly because each stride requires runes, chains and a storm core. Storm Titans are breakthrough weapons, but they still need golem protection.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage03.title: Oath of the Titans
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage04.final: Beyond the gate waits an order that burns every magic but its own. Show them that dragon magic does not ask permission.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage04.intro: Dragon Citadel magic splits into two colors: wild faerie power and ruby force. Both are costly because both must be fed with magic that would kill ordinary soldiers.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage04.lesson: Faerie Dragons punish tight formations with unstable magic. Ruby Dragons are tougher, more direct and better suited to longer fights.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage04.title: Grottos of Broken Magic
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage05.final: The collector came for your gold. He does not understand that in Dragon Citadel, gold walks, flies and burns.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage05.intro: A dragon war is more expensive than an ordinary kingdom. From today you learn not only to win battles, but to feed the city with gold, ore and every rare resource.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage05.lesson: Rust Dragons are expensive because their breath ruins armor and their upkeep devours metal. The Treasury, Dragon Mint and Royal Dragon Mint turn economy into the first real path toward final dragon costs.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage05.title: Treasury of the Storm
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage06.final: At the end of the pass waits an army that has never lost a race. Teach it that the storm is faster than a horse.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage06.intro: The first true storm dragons return to the Citadel. They are not yet the end of the world, but the storm is beginning to obey.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage06.lesson: Storm Dragons are costly because they do not live in simple lairs. They must be fed lightning, magic and metal. Eternal Storm Dragons turn that price into battlefield tempo.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage06.title: The Eternal Storm Approaches
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage07.final: Your rivals believe they have seen the height of your power. Good. Let them die with that mistake.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage07.intro: Azure Dragons do not ask who rules the Citadel. They ask whether the ruler has enough gold, courage and sacrifices to deserve their shadow.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage07.lesson: Azure Dragons are symbols of terror even before level 8. Ancient Azure Dragons cost so much because their presence can break weaker armies before the first strike.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage07.title: The Azure Throne
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage08.final: The sky breaks. The Citadel stands above the clouds. The last dragon opens its eyes, and the world learns why this war cost so much.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage08.intro: Everything you built was only the foundation. The Grail does not give you a dragon for free. It gives you the right to pay a price ordinary kingdoms cannot count.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage08.lesson: Ultimate Dragons cost 150,000 gold and 150 of every resource. Absolute Dragons cost 220,000 gold and 200 of every resource. BILLADENC4 allows only one final dragon to appear each month.
dragon-citadel.campaign.stage08.title: Heart of the End of Ages

dragon-citadel.map01.dc.header.name: 01. Spark of the Citadel
dragon-citadel.map01.dc.header.descripti:
Stare imperium żąda ostatniego podatku od doliny, która nie ma już czego oddać. Billaden gromadzi ocalałych przy niedokończonej Cytadeli. Nie ma smoków. Są kusznicy, kuźnia i decyzja, że następny poborca nie wróci do domu.

Zajmij tartak, kopalnię rudy i kopalnię złota. Rozbij trzy posterunki imperium. Rozdział kończy się najwcześniej piątego dnia, po odprawach o jednostkach.
dragon-citadel.map01.dc.header.victoryMe: Zajmij tartak, kopalnię rudy i kopalnię złota. Rozbij trzy posterunki imperium. Rozdział kończy się najwcześniej piątego dnia, po odprawach o jednostkach.
dragon-citadel.map01.dc.header.defeatMes: Billaden has fallen. The Citadel cannot survive without its ruler.
The old empire demands the last tax from a valley that has nothing left to give back. Billaden gathers the survivors at the unfinished Citadel. There are no dragons. There are crossbowmen, a forge and the decision that the next tax collector will not return home.

Capture the sawmill, the ore mine and the gold mine. Defeat three empire outposts. The chapter ends on the fifth day at the earliest, after the unit briefings.

Mira, quartermaster: "Fourteen crossbows. That's all that's left of the garrison. Behind each one stands a family whose grain was taken by the collector." Billaden does not promise an easy victory. He orders the forge to be opened and a list of the missing to be brought. The first expedition is to recover work and food before he gains fame.

On the trail, look for four chronicles: Square of Empty Banners, Burnt Sawmill, Collectors' Road, Stone of the First Oath.
Sharpshooters come from hunters who guard the ancient dragon trails. Their rune crossbows retain their power across the battlefield: they suffer no distance or wall penalty. Elites also do not lose their effectiveness in melee combat. The price represents years of training and the cost of ammunition, not the number of feathers on the helmet.

Elite Sharpshooter: Attack 16, Defense 14, HP 28, damage 11-14, speed 10. Cost of 1 piece: 800 gold.

Burnt sawmill

The imperial seal hangs on the beam: the wood was confiscated for a siege engine. The old woodcutter, Eric, left cuts under the bark leading to the storeroom. "Give us the sawmill and we will repair the roofs before winter." Behind the outpost there is a supply book with the name: Golden Cores.

The way of the tax collectors

The crossbowmen respond by driving bolts into the imperial tablet. “From now on, we only pay for our own house.” The final fight will open the way to the foundry; Beyond the valley there is an army that cannot be stopped by a volley alone.

The trail of returns

On the road to the mine there are carts of families returning to the valley. The last alliance wants to destroy the supplies before the awakening. Billaden orders the trail to be covered as well as the walls. Without people repairing houses, the Citadel would be just a vault full of weapons.

Roda, Orun and two dragon families guard one circle. Three independent armies are not created: the highest dragons share one monthly pool. Decide which form corresponds to the upcoming battle. Power does not free weaker troops from protection.

After the victory, Billaden will hand over the square to the residents' council. The foundry will remain open and the Titans will remain free.

dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter01.region:
1. Citadel Spark
Capture the sawmill, the ore mine and the gold mine. Defeat three empire outposts. The chapter ends on the fifth day at the earliest, after the unit briefings.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter01.prolog: The old empire demands the last tax from a valley that has nothing left to give back. Billaden gathers the survivors at the unfinished Citadel. There are no dragons. There are crossbowmen, a forge and the decision that the next tax collector will not return home.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter01.epilog: The collector mocked the city without dragons. He died under the first salvo. The smoke of the foundry rises above the reclaimed valley: next time the archers will not fight alone.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter02.region:
2. Gold Cores
Reclaim three mines, build the Ruby Foundry and defeat three intervention forces. Leave room in your army for a new upgrade.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter02.prolog: Matrices of an army older than the empire were found beneath the valley. Founders can awaken gold, but to transform it they need ore and a ruby ​​heart. The royal infantry marches to destroy the forms before they can walk.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter02.epilog: The stone did not escape. The ruby ​​heart endured. The last walker saw light closing the golem's cracks, and distant thunder answered from the mountains.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter03.region:
3. Oath of the Titans
Recapture three core mines, defeat the guards and the mage. Build the Storm Titans Tower to seal the oath.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter03.prolog: The mages attempt to contain the storm within three mining cores. The trapped Titans hear their every turn. Billaden offers them freedom, not obedience. In return, he asks them to stand on the walls of the Citadel.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter03.epilog: The magicians encased the lightning in a crystal. The Titans shattered the crystal and the sky responded. Now we need to find beings who can live in such magic.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter04.region:
4. Caverns of Broken Magic
Save both dragon families: build an improved magic cave in the main citadel and an improved ruby cave in the eastern settlement. Reclaim the mines and defeat three units of the Order.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter04.prolog: In one cave, magic laughs and changes shape; in the second it solidifies into a ruby. The Order of the Pure Flame wants to burn them both. Two Citadel settlements must cover two different dragon families.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter04.epilog: The Order wanted one color of fire. The two spearheads responded with two different powers. The victory cost more than the entire first valley.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter05.region:
5. Treasure of the Storm
Reclaim three mines, defeat the tax collector and his guards. Build the Royal Dragon Mint and keep at least 50,000 gold. Victory is possible from day 8, so that the Treasury can pay the first interest.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter05.prolog: War is not lost only on the battlefield. Dragons need metal and sulfur, Titans need gems, and merchants want gold before delivery. The king's collector cut off three supply routes. This time, Billaden must also defeat the empty vault.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter05.epilog: The collector was looking for boxes. He found gold that walks, flies and burns. The Citadel may finance the next war; For the first time, the price of ultimate power is no longer just a legend.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter06.region:
6. The Eternal Storm is coming
Restore three guide mines, build the Eye of the Eternal Storm, and defeat three cavalry units. Older units remain available.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter06.prolog: Lightning returns to the mountains every night and does not go out at dawn. Three units of the royal cavalry cut off the energy conductors near the mines. Billaden must restore the flow before the storm tears the Citadel apart from the inside.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter06.epilog: The cavalry had never lost a race before. The storm did not pursue the horses. She was waiting at the end of the pass.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter07.region:
7. The Blue Throne
Recapture three resource sources, build a sanctuary for the Ancient Blue Dragons, and defeat the three Throne guards. The relic will be brought to the Citadel at the end of the chapter.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter07.prolog: The last alliance of kings hid the storm relic behind the Blue Throne. The ancient dragons agree to lead Billaden, but their shadow costs more than the crown. The angelic guards do not intend to return the relics.
dragon-citadel.campaign.chapter07.epilog: There was no crown on the throne. The heart of the storm lay there. Billaden ordered the Grail to be taken to the Citadel, although the Titans looked away. The last door should remain closed.
